newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Dec 9.

text.p: Sega Enterprises Ltd and South Korea's Hyundai Group plan to set up a joint venture in Seoul to sell arcade game equipment. The new company will import both finished products and components for local assembly from Japan. The company, capitalised at 690 million yen, will be owned 75 percent by Hyundai and 25 percent by Sega.

Financial institutions and other corporations may be able to sell securities backed by extended housing loans, sales receivables and other credits from the year starting April 1998. The Finance and Justice ministries will pave the way toward setting up a full-fledged market for trading asset-backed securities by establishing mechanisms to protect investors.
